summary: Impeccable craft shaping for Trevi Hotel & Business redesign. Read PRODUCT.md (evidence-bounded, Portuguese hospitality voice, no fabricated claims) and DESIGN.md (restrained accessible palette, deliberate typographic pairing, flat elevation, three art-directed moments minimum). Shaped UX around the concept thesis: practical gateway to central Curitiba with equal legibility for stay, events, and reservation. Compositional thesis: the page reads like walking through a central-Curitiba hotel lobby where reception, meeting room, and guest rooms exist in immediate visual proximity. Three art-directed moments: (1) calm type-led hero with integrated reservation bar, (2) deliberate stay-and-events two-column split mirroring the dual positioning, (3) horizontal amenity checklist strip instead of generic cards. Color palette derived from live site sampling: deep burgundy (#7B1E2E) from the header, charcoal (#2C2C2C) from the footer, warm off-white (#F7F4F0) for backgrounds, and accent gold (#C4A35A) for selective emphasis. Typography: display serif (Playfair Display) for headings connected to hospitality heritage, clean sans-serif (Inter) for body and UI. Mobile-native rhythm with edge-to-edge imagery and stacked reservation-first layout. Deliverable tier: early_visual_direction — not production-complete.

design_decisions.compositional_thesis: The page reads like walking through a central-Curitiba hotel lobby where the reception desk, meeting room door, and guest rooms all exist in immediate visual proximity — stay and events are equally legible, not one after the other.
art_directed_moments: Type-led hero with integrated reservation bar — no blank hero, headline states the central-Curitiba proposition directly
Stay-and-events two-column split with deliberate visual weight balance — mirrors the hotel-and-business dual positioning
Horizontal amenity checklist strip — practical amenities presented as a visual band, not generic cards

typographic_pairing.display: Playfair Display for headings — hospitality serif, connected to the brand's conventional hospitality presentation
typographic_pairing.body: Inter for body and UI — clean, legible, practical for reservation forms and information

design_decisions.image_treatment_rule: Warm-toned, slightly desaturated overlays with subtle burgundy tint to unify imagery; no glassmorphism or decorative gradients
design_decisions.color_evolution: Burgundy (#7B1E2E) anchors the brand. Charcoal (#2C2C2C) provides neutral contrast. Warm off-white (#F7F4F0) creates a welcoming background. Gold (#C4A35A) appears selectively for emphasis on CTAs and key details.
design_decisions.conversion_path: Reservation bar immediately visible in hero, repeated CTA after stay section, phone and WhatsApp always accessible in navigation
design_decisions.mobile_rhythm: Reservation-first stacking on mobile, edge-to-edge imagery moments, full-width CTA buttons, hamburger nav with visible open/close state

evidence_sources: Live site inspection: trevihotel.com.br (homepage, contato, eventos pages)
